email_plci_p1: The PLCI is a savings solution that allows you to supplement your legal pension while benefiting from tax advantages. You contribute according to the amount and frequency of your choice (monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually), with a ceiling fixed at €4,086.34 in 2026. Premiums are deductible as professional expenses, reduce your social security contributions and allow, under certain conditions, to obtain an advance for real estate projects. At maturity, the capital is taxed advantageously.
email_plci_p2: In addition, you can couple your PLCI with a Guaranteed Income insurance for self-employed which compensates for loss of income in case of incapacity for work (illness or accident). It supplements the mutual insurance allowance, is tax deductible, and is intended for self-employed persons under 57 years old living in Belgium. The younger you take it out, the more advantageous it is.
email_plci_p3: The request for an offer regarding your Free Complementary Pension for Self-employed will be made during your next appointment.
email_inami_p1: The INAMI Plan is a scheme intended for conventioned medical care providers. The INAMI intervention is an annual allowance granted by INAMI in return for respecting conventioned rates. It must be invested in a social complementary pension plan, and can also include coverage in case of incapacity for work that protects the self-employed person in case of illness or accident.
email_inami_p2: The amount of the intervention varies according to the profession and situation (e.g.: beginning doctor, intern, etc.).
email_inami_p3: The offer request and simulation regarding your INAMI Plan will be made during your next appointment.
email_eip_p1: The EIP is a pension savings solution intended for company directors. It is a flexible extra-legal benefit that adapts to your needs and situation. You can deduct 100% of the contributions you pay into your EIP as a professional expense, provided you comply with the 80.00% rule.
email_eip_p2: The 80.00% rule sets a maximum for your deductible pension savings. Here is how it works:
email_eip_li_1: The sum of your legal pension and the savings of your complementary pension (like EIP) cannot exceed 80% of your average annual gross salary.
email_eip_li_2: Your gross salary includes not only your monthly salary but also the benefits you receive (like a company car).
email_eip_p3: If you follow this rule, you can benefit from a tax advantage while building a comfortable retirement. In addition, premiums allow, under certain conditions, to obtain an advance for real estate projects. At maturity, the capital is taxed advantageously.
email_eip_p4: In addition, you can couple your EIP with a Guaranteed Income insurance for self-employed which compensates for loss of income in case of incapacity for work (illness or accident). It supplements the mutual insurance allowance, is tax deductible, and is intended for self-employed persons under 57 years old living in Belgium. The younger you take it out, the more advantageous it is.
email_eip_p5: The offer request and simulation regarding your Individual Pension Commitment will be made during your next appointment.
